title: The Book of Ezra Decoded
author: Brittany Johnson
description: The Book of Ezra — every verse decoded into plain, modern English (DMLV).

verses.kjv: Now in the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, that the word of the LORD by the mouth of Jeremiah might be fulfilled, the LORD stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia, that he made a proclamation throughout all his kingdom, and put it also in writing, saying,
verses.decoded: In the first year of Cyrus, king of Persia, to fulfill the word of the LORD spoken through Jeremiah, the LORD moved the heart of Cyrus, king of Persia, so that he sent a message throughout his entire kingdom and also wrote it down, saying,

verses.kjv: Thus saith Cyrus king of Persia, The LORD God of heaven hath given me all the kingdoms of the earth; and he hath charged me to build him an house at Jerusalem, which is in Judah.
verses.decoded: This is what Cyrus, king of Persia, says: The LORD God of heaven has given me all the kingdoms of the earth, and he has commanded me to build a house for him in Jerusalem, which is in Judah.

verses.kjv: Who is there among you of all his people? his God be with him, and let him go up to Jerusalem, which is in Judah, and build the house of the LORD God of Israel, (he is the God,) which is in Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: Who among all his people is there? May his God be with him, and let him go to Jerusalem, which is in Judah, to build the house of the LORD God of Israel, (he is the God,) which is in Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And whosoever remaineth in any place where he sojourneth, let the men of his place help him with silver, and with gold, and with goods, and with beasts, beside the freewill offering for the house of God that is in Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: And whoever stays in any place where they live, let the people of that place help them with silver, gold, goods, and animals, in addition to the voluntary offering for the house of God in Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: Then rose up the chief of the fathers of Judah and Benjamin, and the priests, and the Levites, with all them whose spirit God had raised, to go up to build the house of the LORD which is in Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: Then the leaders of the families of Judah and Benjamin, along with the priests and the Levites, and all those whose spirit God had inspired, got up to go to Jerusalem to rebuild the house of the LORD.

verses.kjv: And all they that were about them strengthened their hands with vessels of silver, with gold, with goods, and with beasts, and with precious things, beside all that was willingly offered.
verses.decoded: And all those around them supported them with silver vessels, gold, goods, animals, and valuable items, in addition to everything that was willingly given.

verses.kjv: Also Cyrus the king brought forth the vessels of the house of the LORD, which Nebuchadnezzar had brought forth out of Jerusalem, and had put them in the house of his gods;
verses.decoded: Also King Cyrus brought out the vessels from the house of the LORD, which Nebuchadnezzar had taken out of Jerusalem and placed in the house of his gods;

verses.kjv: Even those did Cyrus king of Persia bring forth by the hand of Mithredath the treasurer, and numbered them unto Sheshbazzar, the prince of Judah.
verses.decoded: Cyrus, king of Persia, brought those out through Mithredath the treasurer and counted them to Sheshbazzar, the leader of Judah.

verses.kjv: And this is the number of them: thirty chargers of gold, a thousand chargers of silver, nine and twenty knives,
verses.decoded: And this is the number of them: thirty gold plates, one thousand silver plates, twenty-nine knives,

verses.kjv: Thirty basons of gold, silver basons of a second sort four hundred and ten, and other vessels a thousand.
verses.decoded: Thirty gold basins, four hundred and ten silver basins of a different kind, and one thousand other vessels.

verses.kjv: All the vessels of gold and of silver were five thousand and four hundred. All these did Sheshbazzar bring up with them of the captivity that were brought up from Babylon unto Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: There were five thousand four hundred vessels of gold and silver. Sheshbazzar brought all these with the people who were taken captive and brought from Babylon to Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: Now these are the children of the province that went up out of the captivity, of those which had been carried away, whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away unto Babylon, and came again unto Jerusalem and Judah, every one unto his city;
verses.decoded: These are the people from the province who returned from captivity, those who had been taken away by Nebuchadnezzar, the king of Babylon, to Babylon, and who came back to Jerusalem and Judah, each to his own city.

verses.kjv: Which came with Zerubbabel: Jeshua, Nehemiah, Seraiah, Reelaiah, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mizpar, Bigvai, Rehum, Baanah. The number of the men of the people of Israel:
verses.decoded: Those who came with Zerubbabel were Jeshua, Nehemiah, Seraiah, Reelaiah, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mizpar, Bigvai, Rehum, and Baanah. This is the number of the men from the people of Israel:

verses.decoded: The descendants of Pahath-moab, from the descendants of Jeshua and Joab, two thousand eight hundred and twelve.

verses.decoded: The men from Anathoth, one hundred twenty-eight.

verses.decoded: The descendants of Kirjath-arim, Chephirah, and Beeroth were seven hundred forty-three.

verses.decoded: The descendants of Magbish, one hundred fifty-six.

verses.decoded: The descendants of the other Elam were one thousand two hundred fifty-four.

verses.decoded: The descendants of Jericho, three hundred forty-five.

verses.decoded: The priests: the descendants of Jedaiah, from the family of Jeshua, nine hundred seventy-three.

verses.decoded: The descendants of Immer, one thousand fifty-two.

verses.decoded: The Levites: the descendants of Jeshua and Kadmiel, from the descendants of Hodaviah, seventy-four.

verses.decoded: The singers: the descendants of Asaph, one hundred twenty-eight.

verses.kjv: The children of the porters: the children of Shallum, the children of Ater, the children of Talmon, the children of Akkub, the children of Hatita, the children of Shobai, in all an hundred thirty and nine.
verses.decoded: The descendants of the gatekeepers: the descendants of Shallum, the descendants of Ater, the descendants of Talmon, the descendants of Akkub, the descendants of Hatita, the descendants of Shobai, totaling one hundred thirty-nine.

verses.kjv: The Nethinims: the children of Ziha, the children of Hasupha, the children of Tabbaoth,
verses.decoded: The Nethinims: the descendants of Ziha, the descendants of Hasupha, the descendants of Tabbaoth,

verses.decoded: The descendants of Keros, the descendants of Siaha, the descendants of Padon,

verses.decoded: The descendants of Lebanah, the descendants of Hagabah, the descendants of Akkub,

verses.decoded: The descendants of Hagab, the descendants of Shalmai, the descendants of Hanan,

verses.decoded: The descendants of Giddel, the descendants of Gahar, the descendants of Reaiah,

verses.decoded: The descendants of Rezin, the descendants of Nekoda, the descendants of Gazzam,

verses.decoded: The descendants of Uzza, the descendants of Paseah, the descendants of Besai,

verses.decoded: The descendants of Bazluth, the descendants of Mehida, the descendants of Harsha,
