verses.decoded: The descendants of Barkos, the descendants of Sisera, the descendants of Thamah,

verses.kjv: The children of Neziah, the children of Hatipha.
verses.decoded: The descendants of Neziah, the descendants of Hatipha.

verses.kjv: The children of Solomon’s servants: the children of Sotai, the children of Sophereth, the children of Peruda,
verses.decoded: The descendants of Solomon’s servants: the descendants of Sotai, the descendants of Sophereth, the descendants of Peruda,

verses.kjv: The children of Jaalah, the children of Darkon, the children of Giddel,
verses.decoded: The descendants of Jaalah, the descendants of Darkon, the descendants of Giddel,

verses.kjv: The children of Shephatiah, the children of Hattil, the children of Pochereth of Zebaim, the children of Ami.
verses.decoded: The descendants of Shephatiah, the descendants of Hattil, the descendants of Pochereth from Zebaim, the descendants of Ami.

verses.kjv: All the Nethinims, and the children of Solomon’s servants, were three hundred ninety and two.
verses.decoded: All the Nethinims, and the descendants of Solomon’s servants, were three hundred ninety-two.

verses.kjv: And these were they which went up from Telmelah, Telharsa, Cherub, Addan, and Immer: but they could not shew their father’s house, and their seed, whether they were of Israel:
verses.decoded: These are the people who came up from Tel-melah, Tel-harsa, Cherub, Addan, and Immer, but they could not prove their family lineage or their descendants to show whether they belonged to Israel.

verses.kjv: The children of Delaiah, the children of Tobiah, the children of Nekoda, six hundred fifty and two.
verses.decoded: The descendants of Delaiah, the descendants of Tobiah, the descendants of Nekoda, six hundred fifty-two.

verses.kjv: And of the children of the priests: the children of Habaiah, the children of Koz, the children of Barzillai; which took a wife of the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite, and was called after their name:
verses.decoded: And among the descendants of the priests: the descendants of Habaiah, the descendants of Koz, the descendants of Barzillai; who married a wife from the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite, and were named after them:

verses.kjv: These sought their register among those that were reckoned by genealogy, but they were not found: therefore were they, as polluted, put from the priesthood.
verses.decoded: They looked for their names in the list of those recorded by family lineage, but they were not found; so they were considered unclean and excluded from the priesthood.

verses.kjv: And the Tirshatha said unto them, that they should not eat of the most holy things, till there stood up a priest with Urim and with Thummim.
verses.decoded: And the governor told them that they should not eat any of the most holy things until a priest with Urim and Thummim was appointed.

verses.kjv: The whole congregation together was forty and two thousand three hundred and threescore,
verses.decoded: The entire assembly together was 42,360 people,

verses.kjv: Beside their servants and their maids, of whom there were seven thousand three hundred thirty and seven: and there were among them two hundred singing men and singing women.
verses.decoded: In addition to their male and female servants, there were seven thousand three hundred thirty-seven of them; and among them were two hundred men and women who sang.

verses.kjv: Their horses were seven hundred thirty and six; their mules, two hundred forty and five;
verses.decoded: They had seven hundred thirty-six horses; their mules were two hundred forty-five;

verses.kjv: Their camels, four hundred thirty and five; their asses, six thousand seven hundred and twenty.
verses.decoded: They had four hundred thirty-five camels; they had six thousand seven hundred twenty donkeys.

verses.kjv: And some of the chief of the fathers, when they came to the house of the LORD which is at Jerusalem, offered freely for the house of God to set it up in his place:
verses.decoded: And some of the leaders of the families, when they came to the house of the LORD in Jerusalem, gave freely to support the house of God and to restore it in its place:

verses.kjv: They gave after their ability unto the treasure of the work threescore and one thousand drams of gold, and five thousand pound of silver, and one hundred priests’ garments.
verses.decoded: They gave according to their ability to the treasury for the work sixty-one thousand drams of gold, and five thousand pounds of silver, and one hundred priestly garments.

verses.kjv: So the priests, and the Levites, and some of the people, and the singers, and the porters, and the Nethinims, dwelt in their cities, and all Israel in their cities.
verses.decoded: The priests, the Levites, some of the people, the singers, the gatekeepers, and the Nethinims lived in their own cities, and all Israel lived in their own cities.

verses.kjv: And when the seventh month was come, and the children of Israel were in the cities, the people gathered themselves together as one man to Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: When the seventh month arrived and the people of Israel were living in the cities, they all came together as one group in Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: Then stood up Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and his brethren the priests, and Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and his brethren, and builded the altar of the God of Israel, to offer burnt offerings thereon, as it is written in the law of Moses the man of God.
verses.decoded: Then Jeshua, the son of Jozadak, and his fellow priests, and Zerubbabel, the son of Shealtiel, and his companions, stood up and built the altar of the God of Israel to offer burnt offerings on it, as it is written in the law of Moses, the man of God.

verses.kjv: And they set the altar upon his bases; for fear was upon them because of the people of those countries: and they offered burnt offerings thereon unto the LORD, even burnt offerings morning and evening.
verses.decoded: They placed the altar on its foundation because they were afraid of the people from those countries. They offered burnt offerings on it to the LORD, morning and evening.

verses.kjv: They kept also the feast of tabernacles, as it is written, and offered the daily burnt offerings by number, according to the custom, as the duty of every day required;
verses.decoded: They also celebrated the Feast of Tabernacles, as it is written, and offered the daily burnt offerings in the required number, following the custom, as the daily obligation required.

verses.kjv: And afterward offered the continual burnt offering, both of the new moons, and of all the set feasts of the LORD that were consecrated, and of every one that willingly offered a freewill offering unto the LORD.
verses.decoded: And afterward they offered the regular burnt offering, including those for the new moons, all the appointed festivals of the LORD that were made holy, and every person who voluntarily gave a freewill offering to the LORD.

verses.kjv: From the first day of the seventh month began they to offer burnt offerings unto the LORD. But the foundation of the temple of the LORD was not yet laid.
verses.decoded: Starting on the first day of the seventh month, they began to offer burnt offerings to the LORD. However, the foundation of the LORD's temple had not yet been laid.

verses.kjv: They gave money also unto the masons, and to the carpenters; and meat, and drink, and oil, unto them of Zidon, and to them of Tyre, to bring cedar trees from Lebanon to the sea of Joppa, according to the grant that they had of Cyrus king of Persia.
verses.decoded: They also gave money to the masons and the carpenters; and food, drink, and oil to the people of Zidon and the people of Tyre, so they could bring cedar trees from Lebanon to the sea of Joppa, according to the permission they had from Cyrus, king of Persia.

verses.kjv: Now in the second year of their coming unto the house of God at Jerusalem, in the second month, began Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and the remnant of their brethren the priests and the Levites, and all they that were come out of the captivity unto Jerusalem; and appointed the Levites, from twenty years old and upward, to set forward the work of the house of the LORD.
verses.decoded: In the second year after they arrived at the house of God in Jerusalem, in the second month, Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, Jeshua son of Jozadak, the remaining priests and Levites, and all the people who had returned from captivity to Jerusalem began their work; they appointed the Levites who were twenty years old and older to lead the work on the house of the Lord.

verses.kjv: Then stood Jeshua with his sons and his brethren, Kadmiel and his sons, the sons of Judah, together, to set forward the workmen in the house of God: the sons of Henadad, with their sons and their brethren the Levites.
verses.decoded: Then Jeshua stood with his sons and his brothers, Kadmiel and his sons, the sons of Judah, together to encourage the workers in the house of God: the sons of Henadad, with their sons and their brothers, the Levites.

verses.kjv: And when the builders laid the foundation of the temple of the LORD, they set the priests in their apparel with trumpets, and the Levites the sons of Asaph with cymbals, to praise the LORD, after the ordinance of David king of Israel.
verses.decoded: When the builders laid the foundation of the LORD's temple, they placed the priests dressed in their garments with trumpets, and the Levites, the sons of Asaph, with cymbals, to praise the LORD, following the instructions of David, king of Israel.

verses.kjv: And they sang together by course in praising and giving thanks unto the LORD; because he is good, for his mercy endureth for ever toward Israel. And all the people shouted with a great shout, when they praised the LORD, because the foundation of the house of the LORD was laid.
verses.decoded: And they sang together in order, praising and giving thanks to the LORD; because he is good, and his mercy lasts forever toward Israel. And all the people shouted loudly when they praised the LORD, because the foundation of the LORD's house was laid.

verses.kjv: But many of the priests and Levites and chief of the fathers, who were ancient men, that had seen the first house, when the foundation of this house was laid before their eyes, wept with a loud voice; and many shouted aloud for joy:
verses.decoded: But many of the priests, Levites, and leaders of the families, who were old men and had seen the first temple, when the foundation of this temple was laid in front of them, cried out loudly; and many shouted loudly with joy.

verses.kjv: So that the people could not discern the noise of the shout of joy from the noise of the weeping of the people: for the people shouted with a loud shout, and the noise was heard afar off.
verses.decoded: The people could not tell the difference between the sound of their joyful shouting and the sound of their weeping, because the people shouted loudly, and the noise was heard from far away.

verses.kjv: Now when the adversaries of Judah and Benjamin heard that the children of the captivity builded the temple unto the LORD God of Israel;
verses.decoded: Now when the enemies of Judah and Benjamin heard that the people who had been taken captive were rebuilding the temple of the LORD God of Israel,

verses.kjv: Then they came to Zerubbabel, and to the chief of the fathers, and said unto them, Let us build with you: for we seek your God, as ye do; and we do sacrifice unto him since the days of Esarhaddon king of Assur, which brought us up hither.
verses.decoded: Then they came to Zerubbabel and to the leaders of the families and said to them, Let us build with you, because we worship your God just as you do; and we have been sacrificing to him since the days of Esar-haddon, king of Assyria, who brought us here.

verses.kjv: But Zerubbabel, and Jeshua, and the rest of the chief of the fathers of Israel, said unto them, Ye have nothing to do with us to build an house unto our God; but we ourselves together will build unto the LORD God of Israel, as king Cyrus the king of Persia hath commanded us.
verses.decoded: But Zerubbabel, Jeshua, and the rest of the leaders of the families of Israel said to them, You have nothing to do with us in building a house for our God; we ourselves will build the house for the LORD God of Israel, as King Cyrus, the king of Persia, has commanded us.

verses.kjv: Then the people of the land weakened the hands of the people of Judah, and troubled them in building,
verses.decoded: Then the people living in the land discouraged the people of Judah and made it difficult for them to build.

verses.kjv: And hired counsellors against them, to frustrate their purpose, all the days of Cyrus king of Persia, even until the reign of Darius king of Persia.
verses.decoded: They hired advisors to oppose them and to stop their plans during the entire reign of Cyrus, king of Persia, and continued until the reign of Darius, king of Persia.

verses.kjv: And in the reign of Ahasuerus, in the beginning of his reign, wrote they unto him an accusation against the inhabitants of Judah and Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: During the reign of Ahasuerus, at the start of his rule, they wrote to him a complaint against the people living in Judah and Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And in the days of Artaxerxes wrote Bishlam, Mithredath, Tabeel, and the rest of their companions, unto Artaxerxes king of Persia; and the writing of the letter was written in the Syrian tongue, and interpreted in the Syrian tongue.
verses.decoded: During the reign of Artaxerxes, Bishlam, Mithredath, Tabeel, and the rest of their companions wrote a letter to Artaxerxes, king of Persia; the letter was written in the Syrian language and translated into the Syrian language.

verses.kjv: Rehum the chancellor and Shimshai the scribe wrote a letter against Jerusalem to Artaxerxes the king in this sort:
verses.decoded: Rehum the chancellor and Shimshai the scribe wrote a letter opposing Jerusalem to King Artaxerxes in this way:

verses.kjv: Then wrote Rehum the chancellor, and Shimshai the scribe, and the rest of their companions; the Dinaites, the Apharsathchites, the Tarpelites, the Apharsites, the Archevites, the Babylonians, the Susanchites, the Dehavites, and the Elamites,
verses.decoded: Then Rehum the chancellor, Shimshai the scribe, and the rest of their companions wrote; the Dinaites, the Apharsathchites, the Tarpelites, the Apharsites, the Archevites, the Babylonians, the Susanchites, the Dehavites, and the Elamites,

verses.kjv: And the rest of the nations whom the great and noble Asnapper brought over, and set in the cities of Samaria, and the rest that are on this side the river, and at such a time.
verses.decoded: And the other nations whom the great and noble Asnapper brought over and settled in the cities of Samaria, and the others who are on this side of the river, at that time.

verses.kjv: This is the copy of the letter that they sent unto him, even unto Artaxerxes the king; Thy servants the men on this side the river, and at such a time.
verses.decoded: This is the copy of the letter that they sent to him, even to King Artaxerxes: Your servants, the men on this side of the river, at such a time.

verses.kjv: Be it known unto the king, that the Jews which came up from thee to us are come unto Jerusalem, building the rebellious and the bad city, and have set up the walls thereof, and joined the foundations.
verses.decoded: Let the king know that the Jews who came up from you to us have arrived in Jerusalem, building the rebellious and wicked city, and have set up its walls and joined the foundations.

verses.kjv: Be it known now unto the king, that, if this city be builded, and the walls set up again, then will they not pay toll, tribute, and custom, and so thou shalt endamage the revenue of the kings.
verses.decoded: Let the king know now that if this city is rebuilt and the walls are restored, they will not pay tolls, taxes, or customs, and this will harm the king's income.

verses.kjv: Now because we have maintenance from the king’s palace, and it was not meet for us to see the king’s dishonour, therefore have we sent and certified the king;
verses.decoded: Now because we receive support from the king’s palace, and it was not appropriate for us to see the king dishonored, we have sent a message to inform the king;

verses.kjv: That search may be made in the book of the records of thy fathers: so shalt thou find in the book of the records, and know that this city is a rebellious city, and hurtful unto kings and provinces, and that they have moved sedition within the same of old time: for which cause was this city destroyed.
verses.decoded: A search may be made in the book of the records of your ancestors: then you will find in the book of the records and know that this city is a rebellious city, harmful to kings and provinces, and that they have caused rebellion within it from ancient times: for this reason this city was destroyed.

verses.kjv: We certify the king that, if this city be builded again, and the walls thereof set up, by this means thou shalt have no portion on this side the river.
verses.decoded: We inform the king that if this city is rebuilt and its walls are restored, you will have no share on this side of the river.

verses.kjv: Then sent the king an answer unto Rehum the chancellor, and to Shimshai the scribe, and to the rest of their companions that dwell in Samaria, and unto the rest beyond the river, Peace, and at such a time.
verses.decoded: Then the king sent a reply to Rehum the chancellor, to Shimshai the scribe, to their other companions living in Samaria, and to the others beyond the river, saying, 'Peace, and at this time.'

verses.kjv: The letter which ye sent unto us hath been plainly read before me.
verses.decoded: The letter that you sent to us has been clearly read in my presence.

verses.kjv: And I commanded, and search hath been made, and it is found that this city of old time hath made insurrection against kings, and that rebellion and sedition have been made therein.
verses.decoded: And I gave the order, and a search was conducted, and it was found that this city long ago rebelled against kings, and that rebellion and unrest took place there.

verses.kjv: There have been mighty kings also over Jerusalem, which have ruled over all countries beyond the river; and toll, tribute, and custom, was paid unto them.
verses.decoded: There have also been powerful kings over Jerusalem who ruled all the lands beyond the river; and taxes, tribute, and customs were paid to them.

verses.kjv: Give ye now commandment to cause these men to cease, and that this city be not builded, until another commandment shall be given from me.
verses.decoded: Now give the order to stop these men, and to prevent this city from being built until I give another command.

verses.kjv: Take heed now that ye fail not to do this: why should damage grow to the hurt of the kings?
verses.decoded: Be careful now not to fail in doing this: why should harm increase to the injury of the kings?

verses.kjv: Now when the copy of king Artaxerxes’ letter was read before Rehum, and Shimshai the scribe, and their companions, they went up in haste to Jerusalem unto the Jews, and made them to cease by force and power.
verses.decoded: When the copy of King Artaxerxes’ letter was read to Rehum, Shimshai the scribe, and their companions, they quickly went up to Jerusalem to the Jews and forced them to stop by using power and authority.

verses.kjv: Then ceased the work of the house of God which is at Jerusalem. So it ceased unto the second year of the reign of Darius king of Persia.
verses.decoded: Then the work on the house of God in Jerusalem stopped. It remained stopped until the second year of the reign of Darius, king of Persia.

verses.kjv: Then the prophets, Haggai the prophet, and Zechariah the son of Iddo, prophesied unto the Jews that were in Judah and Jerusalem in the name of the God of Israel, even unto them.
verses.decoded: Then the prophets, Haggai the prophet, and Zechariah the son of Iddo, spoke messages from God to the Jews who were in Judah and Jerusalem, delivering God's word to them.

verses.kjv: Then rose up Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and began to build the house of God which is at Jerusalem: and with them were the prophets of God helping them.
verses.decoded: Then Zerubbabel, the son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua, the son of Jozadak, stood up and began to build the house of God in Jerusalem. The prophets of God were with them, helping them.

verses.kjv: At the same time came to them Tatnai, governor on this side the river, and Shetharboznai, and their companions, and said thus unto them, Who hath commanded you to build this house, and to make up this wall?
verses.decoded: At the same time, Tatnai, the governor on this side of the river, and Shethar-boznai, along with their companions, came to them and asked, "Who has given you permission to build this house and to finish this wall?"

verses.kjv: Then said we unto them after this manner, What are the names of the men that make this building?
verses.decoded: Then we said to them in this way, What are the names of the men who are building this?

verses.kjv: But the eye of their God was upon the elders of the Jews, that they could not cause them to cease, till the matter came to Darius: and then they returned answer by letter concerning this matter.
verses.decoded: But the attention of their God was on the leaders of the Jews, so they could not stop them until the issue reached Darius; then they responded with a letter about this matter.

verses.kjv: The copy of the letter that Tatnai, governor on this side the river, and Shetharboznai, and his companions the Apharsachites, which were on this side the river, sent unto Darius the king:
verses.decoded: This is a copy of the letter that Tatnai, the governor on this side of the river, and Shethar-boznai, and his companions the Apharsachites, who were on this side of the river, sent to King Darius:

verses.kjv: They sent a letter unto him, wherein was written thus; Unto Darius the king, all peace.
verses.decoded: They sent a letter to him, in which it was written like this: To King Darius, greetings.

verses.kjv: Be it known unto the king, that we went into the province of Judea, to the house of the great God, which is builded with great stones, and timber is laid in the walls, and this work goeth fast on, and prospereth in their hands.
verses.decoded: Let the king know that we went into the province of Judea, to the house of the great God, which is built with large stones, and wood is placed in the walls, and this work is progressing quickly and succeeding in their hands.

verses.kjv: Then asked we those elders, and said unto them thus, Who commanded you to build this house, and to make up these walls?
verses.decoded: Then we asked those elders and said to them, Who gave you permission to build this house and to finish these walls?

verses.kjv: We asked their names also, to certify thee, that we might write the names of the men that were the chief of them.
verses.decoded: We also asked for their names to confirm to you, so that we could write down the names of the men who were their leaders.

verses.kjv: And thus they returned us answer, saying, We are the servants of the God of heaven and earth, and build the house that was builded these many years ago, which a great king of Israel builded and set up.
verses.decoded: And they answered us, saying, We are the servants of the God of heaven and earth, and we are building the house that was built many years ago, which a great king of Israel built and established.

verses.kjv: But after that our fathers had provoked the God of heaven unto wrath, he gave them into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, the Chaldean, who destroyed this house, and carried the people away into Babylon.
verses.decoded: But after our ancestors made the God of heaven angry, he handed them over to Nebuchadnezzar, the king of Babylon, the Chaldean, who destroyed this temple and took the people away to Babylon.

verses.kjv: But in the first year of Cyrus the king of Babylon the same king Cyrus made a decree to build this house of God.
verses.decoded: But in the first year of Cyrus, the king of Babylon, the same king Cyrus issued a decree to rebuild this house of God.

verses.kjv: And the vessels also of gold and silver of the house of God, which Nebuchadnezzar took out of the temple that was in Jerusalem, and brought them into the temple of Babylon, those did Cyrus the king take out of the temple of Babylon, and they were delivered unto one, whose name was Sheshbazzar, whom he had made governor;
verses.decoded: The gold and silver vessels from the house of God, which Nebuchadnezzar took from the temple in Jerusalem and brought into the temple in Babylon, King Cyrus took those vessels out of the temple in Babylon and gave them to a man named Sheshbazzar, whom he had appointed governor.

verses.kjv: And said unto him, Take these vessels, go, carry them into the temple that is in Jerusalem, and let the house of God be builded in his place.
verses.decoded: And said to him, Take these vessels, go, carry them into the temple that is in Jerusalem, and let the house of God be built in its place.

verses.kjv: Then came the same Sheshbazzar, and laid the foundation of the house of God which is in Jerusalem: and since that time even until now hath it been in building, and yet it is not finished.
verses.decoded: Then Sheshbazzar came and laid the foundation of the house of God in Jerusalem; and from that time until now, it has been under construction, but it is not yet finished.

verses.kjv: Now therefore, if it seem good to the king, let there be search made in the king’s treasure house, which is there at Babylon, whether it be so, that a decree was made of Cyrus the king to build this house of God at Jerusalem, and let the king send his pleasure to us concerning this matter.
verses.decoded: So now, if it is pleasing to the king, let a search be made in the king’s treasury in Babylon to see if a decree was issued by King Cyrus to build this house of God in Jerusalem, and let the king send us his decision about this matter.

verses.kjv: Then Darius the king made a decree, and search was made in the house of the rolls, where the treasures were laid up in Babylon.
verses.decoded: Then King Darius issued a decree, and a search was conducted in the archive room where the records were kept in Babylon.

verses.kjv: And there was found at Achmetha, in the palace that is in the province of the Medes, a roll, and therein was a record thus written:
verses.decoded: A scroll was found at Achmetha, in the palace located in the province of the Medes, and in it was a record written like this:

verses.kjv: In the first year of Cyrus the king the same Cyrus the king made a decree concerning the house of God at Jerusalem, Let the house be builded, the place where they offered sacrifices, and let the foundations thereof be strongly laid; the height thereof threescore cubits, and the breadth thereof threescore cubits;
verses.decoded: In the first year of King Cyrus, the same King Cyrus issued a decree about the house of God in Jerusalem: Let the house be built, the place where they offered sacrifices, and let its foundations be firmly laid; its height shall be sixty cubits, and its width shall be sixty cubits.

verses.kjv: With three rows of great stones, and a row of new timber: and let the expenses be given out of the king’s house:
verses.decoded: Use three rows of large stones and one row of new timber. Let the expenses be paid from the king’s treasury.

verses.kjv: And also let the golden and silver vessels of the house of God, which Nebuchadnezzar took forth out of the temple which is at Jerusalem, and brought unto Babylon, be restored, and brought again unto the temple which is at Jerusalem, every one to his place, and place them in the house of God.
verses.decoded: Also, let the gold and silver vessels of the house of God, which Nebuchadnezzar took out of the temple in Jerusalem and brought to Babylon, be returned and brought back to the temple in Jerusalem, each to its place, and put them in the house of God.

verses.kjv: Now therefore, Tatnai, governor beyond the river, Shetharboznai, and your companions the Apharsachites, which are beyond the river, be ye far from thence:
verses.decoded: So now, Tatnai, governor beyond the river, Shethar-boznai, and your companions the Apharsachites who are beyond the river, stay far away from there:

verses.kjv: Let the work of this house of God alone; let the governor of the Jews and the elders of the Jews build this house of God in his place.
verses.decoded: Stop interfering with the work on this house of God; let the governor of the Jews and the elders of the Jews build this house of God in its place.

verses.kjv: Moreover I make a decree what ye shall do to the elders of these Jews for the building of this house of God: that of the king’s goods, even of the tribute beyond the river, forthwith expenses be given unto these men, that they be not hindered.
verses.decoded: Also, I issue a decree about what you should do for the elders of these Jews for the construction of this house of God: that from the king’s property, even from the tax collected beyond the river, immediate expenses be given to these men so that they are not delayed.

verses.kjv: And that which they have need of, both young bullocks, and rams, and lambs, for the burnt offerings of the God of heaven, wheat, salt, wine, and oil, according to the appointment of the priests which are at Jerusalem, let it be given them day by day without fail:
verses.decoded: And whatever they need, including young bulls, rams, and lambs for the burnt offerings to the God of heaven, as well as wheat, salt, wine, and oil, according to the instructions of the priests in Jerusalem, must be provided to them every day without fail.

verses.kjv: That they may offer sacrifices of sweet savours unto the God of heaven, and pray for the life of the king, and of his sons.
verses.decoded: So that they may offer pleasing sacrifices to the God of heaven and pray for the life of the king and his sons.

verses.kjv: Also I have made a decree, that whosoever shall alter this word, let timber be pulled down from his house, and being set up, let him be hanged thereon; and let his house be made a dunghill for this.
verses.decoded: I have also made a decree that anyone who changes this command will have the wooden beams of their house taken down, and after they are set up, they will be hanged on them; and their house will be made into a pile of refuse because of this.

verses.kjv: And the God that hath caused his name to dwell there destroy all kings and people, that shall put to their hand to alter and to destroy this house of God which is at Jerusalem. I Darius have made a decree; let it be done with speed.
verses.decoded: And may the God who caused his name to live there destroy every king and person who tries to change or destroy this house of God in Jerusalem. I, Darius, have made a decree; let it be carried out quickly.

verses.kjv: Then Tatnai, governor on this side the river, Shetharboznai, and their companions, according to that which Darius the king had sent, so they did speedily.
verses.decoded: Then Tatnai, the governor on this side of the river, Shethar-boznai, and their companions, followed exactly what King Darius had commanded, and they acted quickly.

verses.kjv: And the elders of the Jews builded, and they prospered through the prophesying of Haggai the prophet and Zechariah the son of Iddo. And they builded, and finished it, according to the commandment of the God of Israel, and according to the commandment of Cyrus, and Darius, and Artaxerxes king of Persia.
verses.decoded: The leaders of the Jews built, and they succeeded because of the messages from Haggai the prophet and Zechariah the son of Iddo. They built and completed it according to the instructions from the God of Israel and according to the orders of Cyrus, Darius, and Artaxerxes, kings of Persia.

verses.kjv: And this house was finished on the third day of the month Adar, which was in the sixth year of the reign of Darius the king.
verses.decoded: This building was completed on the third day of the month Adar, in the sixth year of King Darius's rule.

verses.kjv: And the children of Israel, the priests, and the Levites, and the rest of the children of the captivity, kept the dedication of this house of God with joy,
verses.decoded: The people of Israel, the priests, the Levites, and all the other people who had been taken captive celebrated the dedication of this house of God with joy,

verses.kjv: And offered at the dedication of this house of God an hundred bullocks, two hundred rams, four hundred lambs; and for a sin offering for all Israel, twelve he goats, according to the number of the tribes of Israel.
verses.decoded: And they offered at the dedication of this house of God one hundred bulls, two hundred rams, four hundred lambs; and for a sin offering for all Israel, twelve male goats, corresponding to the number of the tribes of Israel.

verses.kjv: And they set the priests in their divisions, and the Levites in their courses, for the service of God, which is at Jerusalem; as it is written in the book of Moses.
verses.decoded: They assigned the priests to their groups and the Levites to their duties for the service of God in Jerusalem, just as it is written in the book of Moses.

verses.kjv: And the children of the captivity kept the passover upon the fourteenth day of the first month.
verses.decoded: The people who had been taken captive celebrated the Passover on the fourteenth day of the first month.

verses.kjv: For the priests and the Levites were purified together, all of them were pure, and killed the passover for all the children of the captivity, and for their brethren the priests, and for themselves.
verses.decoded: The priests and the Levites were purified together; all of them were clean, and they sacrificed the Passover for all the people who had been taken captive, for their fellow priests, and for themselves.

verses.kjv: And the children of Israel, which were come again out of captivity, and all such as had separated themselves unto them from the filthiness of the heathen of the land, to seek the LORD God of Israel, did eat,
verses.decoded: And the people of Israel, who had returned from captivity, and all who had separated themselves from the impurities of the non-Israelite people of the land to seek the LORD God of Israel, ate,

verses.kjv: And kept the feast of unleavened bread seven days with joy: for the LORD had made them joyful, and turned the heart of the king of Assyria unto them, to strengthen their hands in the work of the house of God, the God of Israel.
verses.decoded: They celebrated the Feast of Unleavened Bread for seven days with happiness because the LORD made them joyful and changed the heart of the king of Assyria toward them to encourage them in the work on the house of God, the God of Israel.

verses.kjv: Now after these things, in the reign of Artaxerxes king of Persia, Ezra the son of Seraiah, the son of Azariah, the son of Hilkiah,
verses.decoded: After these events, during the reign of Artaxerxes, king of Persia, Ezra, the son of Seraiah, the son of Azariah, the son of Hilkiah,

verses.kjv: The son of Shallum, the son of Zadok, the son of Ahitub,
verses.decoded: The son of Shallum, the son of Zadok, the son of Ahitub,

verses.kjv: The son of Amariah, the son of Azariah, the son of Meraioth,
verses.decoded: The son of Amariah, the son of Azariah, the son of Meraioth,

verses.kjv: The son of Zerahiah, the son of Uzzi, the son of Bukki,
verses.decoded: The son of Zerahiah, the son of Uzzi, the son of Bukki,

verses.kjv: The son of Abishua, the son of Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the chief priest:
verses.decoded: He was the son of Abishua, who was the son of Phinehas, who was the son of Eleazar, who was the son of Aaron the chief priest.

verses.kjv: This Ezra went up from Babylon; and he was a ready scribe in the law of Moses, which the LORD God of Israel had given: and the king granted him all his request, according to the hand of the LORD his God upon him.
verses.decoded: Ezra came up from Babylon, and he was an expert scribe in the law of Moses, which the LORD God of Israel had given. The king gave him everything he asked for, because the LORD his God was helping him.

verses.kjv: And there went up some of the children of Israel, and of the priests, and the Levites, and the singers, and the porters, and the Nethinims, unto Jerusalem, in the seventh year of Artaxerxes the king.
verses.decoded: Some of the people of Israel, including the priests, the Levites, the singers, the gatekeepers, and the Nethinims, went up to Jerusalem in the seventh year of King Artaxerxes.

verses.kjv: And he came to Jerusalem in the fifth month, which was in the seventh year of the king.
verses.decoded: He arrived in Jerusalem in the fifth month, during the seventh year of the king's reign.

verses.kjv: For upon the first day of the first month began he to go up from Babylon, and on the first day of the fifth month came he to Jerusalem, according to the good hand of his God upon him.
verses.decoded: Because on the first day of the first month, he began to travel from Babylon, and on the first day of the fifth month, he arrived in Jerusalem, following the favorable guidance of his God.

verses.kjv: For Ezra had prepared his heart to seek the law of the LORD, and to do it, and to teach in Israel statutes and judgments.
verses.decoded: Ezra had made up his mind to study the law of the LORD, to obey it, and to teach the people of Israel the rules and decisions.

verses.kjv: Now this is the copy of the letter that the king Artaxerxes gave unto Ezra the priest, the scribe, even a scribe of the words of the commandments of the LORD, and of his statutes to Israel.
verses.decoded: This is the copy of the letter that King Artaxerxes gave to Ezra the priest, the scribe, who was a scribe of the words of the commandments of the LORD and of his laws to Israel.

verses.kjv: Artaxerxes, king of kings, unto Ezra the priest, a scribe of the law of the God of heaven, perfect peace, and at such a time.
verses.decoded: Artaxerxes, king of kings, to Ezra the priest, a teacher of the law of the God of heaven, greetings and complete peace, at this time.

verses.kjv: I make a decree, that all they of the people of Israel, and of his priests and Levites, in my realm, which are minded of their own freewill to go up to Jerusalem, go with thee.
verses.decoded: I issue a decree that all the people of Israel, including the priests and Levites in my kingdom, who willingly want to go to Jerusalem, may go with you.

verses.kjv: Forasmuch as thou art sent of the king, and of his seven counsellors, to enquire concerning Judah and Jerusalem, according to the law of thy God which is in thine hand;
verses.decoded: Because you have been sent by the king and his seven counselors to investigate matters concerning Judah and Jerusalem, according to the law of your God which is in your hand;

verses.kjv: And to carry the silver and gold, which the king and his counsellors have freely offered unto the God of Israel, whose habitation is in Jerusalem,
verses.decoded: And to carry the silver and gold, which the king and his advisors have freely given to the God of Israel, whose home is in Jerusalem,

verses.kjv: And all the silver and gold that thou canst find in all the province of Babylon, with the freewill offering of the people, and of the priests, offering willingly for the house of their God which is in Jerusalem:
verses.decoded: And all the silver and gold that you can find in the entire province of Babylon, along with the voluntary offerings of the people and the priests, who are willingly giving for the house of their God in Jerusalem:

verses.kjv: That thou mayest buy speedily with this money bullocks, rams, lambs, with their meat offerings and their drink offerings, and offer them upon the altar of the house of your God which is in Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: So that you may quickly buy with this money bulls, rams, lambs, along with their grain offerings and their drink offerings, and offer them on the altar of the house of your God in Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And whatsoever shall seem good to thee, and to thy brethren, to do with the rest of the silver and the gold, that do after the will of your God.
verses.decoded: And whatever seems good to you and your brothers to do with the rest of the silver and gold, do it according to the will of your God.

verses.kjv: The vessels also that are given thee for the service of the house of thy God, those deliver thou before the God of Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: Also, the vessels that are given to you for the service of the house of your God, deliver those before the God of Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And whatsoever more shall be needful for the house of thy God, which thou shalt have occasion to bestow, bestow it out of the king’s treasure house.
verses.decoded: And whatever else is necessary for the house of your God, which you have the opportunity to provide, provide it from the king’s treasury.

verses.kjv: And I, even I Artaxerxes the king, do make a decree to all the treasurers which are beyond the river, that whatsoever Ezra the priest, the scribe of the law of the God of heaven, shall require of you, it be done speedily,
verses.decoded: I, Artaxerxes the king, make a decree to all the treasurers beyond the river that whatever Ezra the priest, the scribe of the law of the God of heaven, asks from you, it must be done quickly.

verses.kjv: Unto an hundred talents of silver, and to an hundred measures of wheat, and to an hundred baths of wine, and to an hundred baths of oil, and salt without prescribing how much.
verses.decoded: One hundred talents of silver, one hundred measures of wheat, one hundred baths of wine, one hundred baths of oil, and salt without specifying the amount.

verses.kjv: Whatsoever is commanded by the God of heaven, let it be diligently done for the house of the God of heaven: for why should there be wrath against the realm of the king and his sons?
verses.decoded: Whatever is commanded by the God of heaven, let it be carefully done for the house of the God of heaven, because why should there be anger against the kingdom of the king and his sons?

verses.kjv: Also we certify you, that touching any of the priests and Levites, singers, porters, Nethinims, or ministers of this house of God, it shall not be lawful to impose toll, tribute, or custom, upon them.
verses.decoded: We also confirm to you that regarding any of the priests and Levites, singers, gatekeepers, Nethinims, or servants of this house of God, it will not be allowed to charge them toll, tax, or customs.

verses.kjv: And thou, Ezra, after the wisdom of thy God, that is in thine hand, set magistrates and judges, which may judge all the people that are beyond the river, all such as know the laws of thy God; and teach ye them that know them not.
verses.decoded: And you, Ezra, according to the wisdom of your God, which is in your hand, appoint magistrates and judges who can judge all the people beyond the river, all who know the laws of your God; and teach those who do not know them.

verses.kjv: And whosoever will not do the law of thy God, and the law of the king, let judgment be executed speedily upon him, whether it be unto death, or to banishment, or to confiscation of goods, or to imprisonment.
verses.decoded: And anyone who will not obey the law of your God and the law of the king, let judgment be carried out quickly on them, whether it is to death, or to banishment, or to confiscation of property, or to imprisonment.

verses.kjv: Blessed be the LORD God of our fathers, which hath put such a thing as this in the king’s heart, to beautify the house of the LORD which is in Jerusalem:
verses.decoded: Praise the LORD God of our ancestors, who has put this idea into the king’s heart to beautify the house of the LORD in Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And hath extended mercy unto me before the king, and his counsellors, and before all the king’s mighty princes. And I was strengthened as the hand of the LORD my God was upon me, and I gathered together out of Israel chief men to go up with me.
verses.decoded: And he has shown mercy to me in front of the king, his advisors, and all the king’s powerful princes. I was strengthened because the LORD my God was with me, and I gathered leading men from Israel to go with me.

verses.kjv: These are now the chief of their fathers, and this is the genealogy of them that went up with me from Babylon, in the reign of Artaxerxes the king.
verses.decoded: These are now the leaders of their families, and this is the family record of those who went up with me from Babylon during the reign of King Artaxerxes.

verses.kjv: Of the sons of Phinehas; Gershom: of the sons of Ithamar; Daniel: of the sons of David; Hattush.
verses.decoded: From the descendants of Phinehas: Gershom; from the descendants of Ithamar: Daniel; from the descendants of David: Hattush.

verses.kjv: Of the sons of Shechaniah, of the sons of Pharosh; Zechariah: and with him were reckoned by genealogy of the males an hundred and fifty.
verses.decoded: From the descendants of Shechaniah, from the descendants of Pharosh, Zechariah: and with him, according to the genealogy of the males, there were one hundred and fifty.

verses.kjv: Of the sons of Pahathmoab; Elihoenai the son of Zerahiah, and with him two hundred males.
verses.decoded: From the descendants of Pahath-moab: Elihoenai, the son of Zerahiah, and with him two hundred men.

verses.kjv: Of the sons of Shechaniah; the son of Jahaziel, and with him three hundred males.
verses.decoded: From the descendants of Shechaniah, the son of Jahaziel, and with him three hundred men.

verses.kjv: Of the sons also of Adin; Ebed the son of Jonathan, and with him fifty males.
verses.decoded: Also from the descendants of Adin: Ebed, the son of Jonathan, and with him fifty men.

verses.kjv: And of the sons of Elam; Jeshaiah the son of Athaliah, and with him seventy males.
verses.decoded: And from the descendants of Elam: Jeshaiah, the son of Athaliah, and with him seventy men.

verses.kjv: And of the sons of Shephatiah; Zebadiah the son of Michael, and with him fourscore males.
verses.decoded: And from the descendants of Shephatiah, Zebadiah son of Michael, and with him eighty males.

verses.kjv: Of the sons of Joab; Obadiah the son of Jehiel, and with him two hundred and eighteen males.
verses.decoded: From the descendants of Joab: Obadiah, the son of Jehiel, and with him two hundred and eighteen men.

verses.kjv: And of the sons of Shelomith; the son of Josiphiah, and with him an hundred and threescore males.
verses.decoded: And from the descendants of Shelomith, the son of Josiphiah, there were one hundred and sixty males with him.

verses.kjv: And of the sons of Bebai; Zechariah the son of Bebai, and with him twenty and eight males.
verses.decoded: And from the descendants of Bebai: Zechariah, the son of Bebai, and with him twenty-eight males.

verses.kjv: And of the sons of Azgad; Johanan the son of Hakkatan, and with him an hundred and ten males.
verses.decoded: And from the sons of Azgad: Johanan, the son of Hakkatan, and with him one hundred and ten males.

verses.kjv: And of the last sons of Adonikam, whose names are these, Eliphelet, Jeiel, and Shemaiah, and with them threescore males.
verses.decoded: And from the remaining sons of Adonikam, whose names are Eliphelet, Jeiel, and Shemaiah, there were with them sixty males.

verses.kjv: Of the sons also of Bigvai; Uthai, and Zabbud, and with them seventy males.
verses.decoded: Also among the descendants of Bigvai were Uthai and Zabbud, along with seventy men.

verses.kjv: And I gathered them together to the river that runneth to Ahava; and there abode we in tents three days: and I viewed the people, and the priests, and found there none of the sons of Levi.
verses.decoded: I gathered them together at the river that flows to Ahava, and we stayed there in tents for three days. I examined the people and the priests and found that there were no descendants of Levi among them.

verses.kjv: Then sent I for Eliezer, for Ariel, for Shemaiah, and for Elnathan, and for Jarib, and for Elnathan, and for Nathan, and for Zechariah, and for Meshullam, chief men; also for Joiarib, and for Elnathan, men of understanding.
verses.decoded: Then I sent for Eliezer, Ariel, Shemaiah, Elnathan, Jarib, Elnathan, Nathan, Zechariah, and Meshullam, the leaders; also for Joiarib and Elnathan, men with insight.

verses.kjv: And I sent them with commandment unto Iddo the chief at the place Casiphia, and I told them what they should say unto Iddo, and to his brethren the Nethinims, at the place Casiphia, that they should bring unto us ministers for the house of our God.
verses.decoded: And I sent them with instructions to Iddo the leader at the place Casiphia, and I told them what to say to Iddo and to his fellow Nethinims at the place Casiphia, that they should bring us ministers for the house of our God.

verses.kjv: And by the good hand of our God upon us they brought us a man of understanding, of the sons of Mahli, the son of Levi, the son of Israel; and Sherebiah, with his sons and his brethren, eighteen;
verses.decoded: Because of the good hand of our God on us, they brought us a wise man from the descendants of Mahli, the son of Levi, the son of Israel; and Sherebiah, along with his sons and brothers, eighteen in total;

verses.kjv: And Hashabiah, and with him Jeshaiah of the sons of Merari, his brethren and their sons, twenty;
verses.decoded: And Hashabiah, along with Jeshaiah from the sons of Merari, his brothers and their sons, twenty in total;

verses.kjv: Also of the Nethinims, whom David and the princes had appointed for the service of the Levites, two hundred and twenty Nethinims: all of them were expressed by name.
verses.decoded: Also, there were two hundred and twenty Nethinims, whom David and the leaders had assigned to serve the Levites; all of them were listed by name.

verses.kjv: Then I proclaimed a fast there, at the river of Ahava, that we might afflict ourselves before our God, to seek of him a right way for us, and for our little ones, and for all our substance.
verses.decoded: Then I announced a fast there, at the river of Ahava, so that we could humble ourselves before our God, to ask Him for the right path for us, for our children, and for all our possessions.

verses.kjv: For I was ashamed to require of the king a band of soldiers and horsemen to help us against the enemy in the way: because we had spoken unto the king, saying, The hand of our God is upon all them for good that seek him; but his power and his wrath is against all them that forsake him.
verses.decoded: Because I was embarrassed to ask the king for a group of soldiers and horsemen to protect us from enemies on the road, since we had already told the king, 'The hand of our God is on everyone who seeks him for good, but his power and anger are against everyone who abandons him.'

verses.kjv: So we fasted and besought our God for this: and he was intreated of us.
verses.decoded: So we fasted and prayed to our God about this, and he listened to us.

verses.kjv: Then I separated twelve of the chief of the priests, Sherebiah, Hashabiah, and ten of their brethren with them,
verses.decoded: Then I chose twelve of the leading priests: Sherebiah, Hashabiah, and ten of their fellow priests with them,

verses.kjv: And weighed unto them the silver, and the gold, and the vessels, even the offering of the house of our God, which the king, and his counsellors, and his lords, and all Israel there present, had offered:
verses.decoded: And they weighed the silver, the gold, and the vessels, which were the offering for the house of our God, that the king, his counselors, his officials, and all Israel present had offered.

verses.kjv: I even weighed unto their hand six hundred and fifty talents of silver, and silver vessels an hundred talents, and of gold an hundred talents;
verses.decoded: I gave them six hundred and fifty talents of silver, silver vessels worth one hundred talents, and gold worth one hundred talents.

verses.kjv: Also twenty basons of gold, of a thousand drams; and two vessels of fine copper, precious as gold.
verses.decoded: Also twenty gold basins, each weighing a thousand drams; and two vessels of fine copper, as valuable as gold.

verses.kjv: And I said unto them, Ye are holy unto the LORD; the vessels are holy also; and the silver and the gold are a freewill offering unto the LORD God of your fathers.
verses.decoded: And I said to them, You are holy to the LORD; the vessels are holy also; and the silver and the gold are a voluntary offering to the LORD God of your ancestors.

verses.kjv: Watch ye, and keep them, until ye weigh them before the chief of the priests and the Levites, and chief of the fathers of Israel, at Jerusalem, in the chambers of the house of the LORD.
verses.decoded: Watch and guard them until you weigh them in front of the chief priests, the Levites, and the leaders of the families of Israel, in Jerusalem, inside the rooms of the house of the LORD.

verses.kjv: So took the priests and the Levites the weight of the silver, and the gold, and the vessels, to bring them to Jerusalem unto the house of our God.
verses.decoded: Then the priests and the Levites weighed the silver, the gold, and the vessels to bring them to Jerusalem to the house of our God.

verses.kjv: Then we departed from the river of Ahava on the twelfth day of the first month, to go unto Jerusalem: and the hand of our God was upon us, and he delivered us from the hand of the enemy, and of such as lay in wait by the way.
verses.decoded: Then we left the river of Ahava on the twelfth day of the first month to go to Jerusalem, and God's power was with us, and he saved us from the enemy and from those who were lying in wait along the road.

verses.kjv: And we came to Jerusalem, and abode there three days.
verses.decoded: We arrived in Jerusalem and stayed there for three days.

verses.kjv: Now on the fourth day was the silver and the gold and the vessels weighed in the house of our God by the hand of Meremoth the son of Uriah the priest; and with him was Eleazar the son of Phinehas; and with them was Jozabad the son of Jeshua, and Noadiah the son of Binnui, Levites;
verses.decoded: On the fourth day, the silver, the gold, and the vessels were weighed in the house of our God by Meremoth, the son of Uriah the priest; with him was Eleazar, the son of Phinehas; and with them were Jozabad, the son of Jeshua, and Noadiah, the son of Binnui, Levites.

verses.kjv: By number and by weight of every one: and all the weight was written at that time.
verses.decoded: By the count and the weight of each item: and all the weights were recorded at that time.

verses.kjv: Also the children of those that had been carried away, which were come out of the captivity, offered burnt offerings unto the God of Israel, twelve bullocks for all Israel, ninety and six rams, seventy and seven lambs, twelve he goats for a sin offering: all this was a burnt offering unto the LORD.
verses.decoded: Also the descendants of those who had been taken captive, who had come out of captivity, offered burnt offerings to the God of Israel: twelve bulls for all Israel, ninety-six rams, seventy-seven lambs, and twelve male goats as a sin offering; all of these were burnt offerings to the LORD.

verses.kjv: And they delivered the king’s commissions unto the king’s lieutenants, and to the governors on this side the river: and they furthered the people, and the house of God.
verses.decoded: They gave the king’s orders to the king’s officers and to the governors on this side of the river, and they helped the people and the house of God.

verses.kjv: Now when these things were done, the princes came to me, saying, The people of Israel, and the priests, and the Levites, have not separated themselves from the people of the lands, doing according to their abominations, even of the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Jebusites, the Ammonites, the Moabites, the Egyptians, and the Amorites.
verses.decoded: After these events were completed, the leaders came to me and said, The people of Israel, including the priests and the Levites, have not separated themselves from the people of the land. They have been following the detestable practices of the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Jebusites, the Ammonites, the Moabites, the Egyptians, and the Amorites.

verses.kjv: For they have taken of their daughters for themselves, and for their sons: so that the holy seed have mingled themselves with the people of those lands: yea, the hand of the princes and rulers hath been chief in this trespass.
verses.decoded: Because they have taken the daughters of those people for themselves and for their sons, so that the holy descendants have mixed themselves with the people of those lands. Yes, the leaders and rulers were mainly responsible for this wrongdoing.

verses.kjv: And when I heard this thing, I rent my garment and my mantle, and plucked off the hair of my head and of my beard, and sat down astonied.
verses.decoded: When I heard this, I tore my clothes and my outer garment, pulled out the hair from my head and beard, and sat down shocked.

verses.kjv: Then were assembled unto me every one that trembled at the words of the God of Israel, because of the transgression of those that had been carried away; and I sat astonied until the evening sacrifice.
verses.decoded: Then everyone who was afraid of the words of the God of Israel because of the sins of those who had been taken captive gathered to me, and I sat shocked until the evening sacrifice.

verses.kjv: And at the evening sacrifice I arose up from my heaviness; and having rent my garment and my mantle, I fell upon my knees, and spread out my hands unto the LORD my God,
verses.decoded: At the time of the evening sacrifice, I got up from my sadness; and after tearing my clothes and my outer garment, I knelt down and stretched out my hands to the LORD my God.

verses.kjv: And said, O my God, I am ashamed and blush to lift up my face to thee, my God: for our iniquities are increased over our head, and our trespass is grown up unto the heavens.
verses.decoded: And said, O my God, I am ashamed and embarrassed to look up to you, my God, because our sins have piled up above our heads, and our wrongdoing has reached to the heavens.

verses.kjv: Since the days of our fathers have we been in a great trespass unto this day; and for our iniquities have we, our kings, and our priests, been delivered into the hand of the kings of the lands, to the sword, to captivity, and to a spoil, and to confusion of face, as it is this day.
verses.decoded: Since the time of our ancestors, we have been in great sin up to this day; because of our sins, we, our kings, and our priests have been handed over to the kings of other lands, to be killed by the sword, taken captive, plundered, and shamed, just as it is today.

verses.kjv: And now for a little space grace hath been shewed from the LORD our God, to leave us a remnant to escape, and to give us a nail in his holy place, that our God may lighten our eyes, and give us a little reviving in our bondage.
verses.decoded: And now, for a short time, the LORD our God has shown us kindness by leaving us a small group to escape and by giving us a secure place in his holy temple, so that our God may give us hope and restore us a little while we are in captivity.

verses.kjv: For we were bondmen; yet our God hath not forsaken us in our bondage, but hath extended mercy unto us in the sight of the kings of Persia, to give us a reviving, to set up the house of our God, and to repair the desolations thereof, and to give us a wall in Judah and in Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: For we were slaves; yet our God has not abandoned us during our slavery, but has shown mercy to us in the eyes of the kings of Persia, to give us new life, to rebuild the house of our God, to restore its ruins, and to give us protection in Judah and in Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And now, O our God, what shall we say after this? for we have forsaken thy commandments,
verses.decoded: And now, O our God, what can we say after this? Because we have abandoned your commandments,

verses.kjv: Which thou hast commanded by thy servants the prophets, saying, The land, unto which ye go to possess it, is an unclean land with the filthiness of the people of the lands, with their abominations, which have filled it from one end to another with their uncleanness.
verses.decoded: Which you have commanded through your servants the prophets, saying, The land that you are going to take possession of is an unclean land because of the filthiness of the people who live there, with their detestable practices that have filled it from one end to the other with their uncleanness.

verses.kjv: Now therefore give not your daughters unto their sons, neither take their daughters unto your sons, nor seek their peace or their wealth for ever: that ye may be strong, and eat the good of the land, and leave it for an inheritance to your children for ever.
verses.decoded: So now, do not give your daughters to their sons, and do not take their daughters for your sons. Do not try to make peace with them or seek their wealth forever. This is so that you may be strong, enjoy the good things of the land, and leave it as an inheritance to your children forever.

verses.kjv: And after all that is come upon us for our evil deeds, and for our great trespass, seeing that thou our God hast punished us less than our iniquities deserve, and hast given us such deliverance as this;
verses.decoded: And after everything that has happened to us because of our evil actions and our great sins, since you, our God, have punished us less than we deserve for our wrongdoings, and have given us this kind of rescue;

verses.kjv: Should we again break thy commandments, and join in affinity with the people of these abominations? wouldest not thou be angry with us till thou hadst consumed us, so that there should be no remnant nor escaping?
verses.decoded: Should we break your commandments again and associate with the people who do these disgusting things? Would you not be angry with us until you destroyed us completely, leaving no survivors or escape?

verses.kjv: O LORD God of Israel, thou art righteous: for we remain yet escaped, as it is this day: behold, we are before thee in our trespasses: for we cannot stand before thee because of this.
verses.decoded: O LORD God of Israel, you are righteous, because we have escaped so far, as it is today. Look, we are here before you because of our sins; we cannot stand in your presence because of this.

verses.kjv: Now when Ezra had prayed, and when he had confessed, weeping and casting himself down before the house of God, there assembled unto him out of Israel a very great congregation of men and women and children: for the people wept very sore.
verses.decoded: When Ezra had prayed and confessed, crying and throwing himself down in front of the house of God, a very large group of men, women, and children from Israel gathered around him because the people were crying very hard.

verses.kjv: And Shechaniah the son of Jehiel, one of the sons of Elam, answered and said unto Ezra, We have trespassed against our God, and have taken strange wives of the people of the land: yet now there is hope in Israel concerning this thing.
verses.decoded: And Shechaniah, the son of Jehiel, one of the sons of Elam, answered and said to Ezra, We have sinned against our God by marrying foreign wives from the people of the land; but now there is hope for Israel regarding this matter.

verses.kjv: Now therefore let us make a covenant with our God to put away all the wives, and such as are born of them, according to the counsel of my lord, and of those that tremble at the commandment of our God; and let it be done according to the law.
verses.decoded: So now, let us make a promise to our God to send away all the wives, and their children, following the advice of my leader and those who respect the commandment of our God; and let it be done according to the law.

verses.kjv: Arise; for this matter belongeth unto thee: we also will be with thee: be of good courage, and do it.
verses.decoded: Get up; this matter concerns you: we will also be with you: be brave, and do it.

verses.kjv: Then arose Ezra, and made the chief priests, the Levites, and all Israel, to swear that they should do according to this word. And they sware.
verses.decoded: Then Ezra stood up and made the chief priests, the Levites, and all Israel swear that they would obey this instruction. And they swore.

verses.kjv: Then Ezra rose up from before the house of God, and went into the chamber of Johanan the son of Eliashib: and when he came thither, he did eat no bread, nor drink water: for he mourned because of the transgression of them that had been carried away.
verses.decoded: Then Ezra got up from in front of the house of God and went into the room of Johanan, the son of Eliashib. When he arrived there, he did not eat any bread or drink any water because he was grieving over the sins of those who had been taken captive.

verses.kjv: And they made proclamation throughout Judah and Jerusalem unto all the children of the captivity, that they should gather themselves together unto Jerusalem;
verses.decoded: They announced throughout Judah and Jerusalem to all the exiles that they should come together in Jerusalem;

verses.kjv: And that whosoever would not come within three days, according to the counsel of the princes and the elders, all his substance should be forfeited, and himself separated from the congregation of those that had been carried away.
verses.decoded: And whoever would not come within three days, according to the advice of the leaders and the elders, all of his property would be taken away, and he himself would be separated from the group of those who had been exiled.

verses.kjv: Then all the men of Judah and Benjamin gathered themselves together unto Jerusalem within three days. It was the ninth month, on the twentieth day of the month; and all the people sat in the street of the house of God, trembling because of this matter, and for the great rain.
verses.decoded: Then all the men of Judah and Benjamin gathered together in Jerusalem within three days. It was the ninth month, on the twentieth day of the month; and all the people sat in the street of the house of God, trembling because of this situation and because of the heavy rain.

verses.kjv: And Ezra the priest stood up, and said unto them, Ye have transgressed, and have taken strange wives, to increase the trespass of Israel.
verses.decoded: And Ezra the priest stood up and said to them, You have sinned and have taken foreign wives, increasing the sin of Israel.

verses.kjv: Now therefore make confession unto the LORD God of your fathers, and do his pleasure: and separate yourselves from the people of the land, and from the strange wives.
verses.decoded: So now, confess to the LORD God of your ancestors, and do what pleases him: separate yourselves from the people of the land and from the foreign wives.

verses.kjv: Then all the congregation answered and said with a loud voice, As thou hast said, so must we do.
verses.decoded: Then the whole group answered loudly, "What you have said is what we must do."

verses.kjv: But the people are many, and it is a time of much rain, and we are not able to stand without, neither is this a work of one day or two: for we are many that have transgressed in this thing.
verses.decoded: But there are many people, and it is a time of heavy rain, so we cannot stand outside, and this is not a task that can be done in one or two days, because many of us have sinned in this matter.

verses.kjv: Let now our rulers of all the congregation stand, and let all them which have taken strange wives in our cities come at appointed times, and with them the elders of every city, and the judges thereof, until the fierce wrath of our God for this matter be turned from us.
verses.decoded: Let the leaders of the entire assembly stand, and let all who have married foreign wives in our cities come at the appointed times, along with the elders and judges of each city, until the intense anger of our God over this matter is turned away from us.

verses.kjv: Only Jonathan the son of Asahel and Jahaziah the son of Tikvah were employed about this matter: and Meshullam and Shabbethai the Levite helped them.
verses.decoded: Only Jonathan, the son of Asahel, and Jahaziah, the son of Tikvah, were assigned to this task, and Meshullam and Shabbethai, the Levite, helped them.

verses.kjv: And the children of the captivity did so. And Ezra the priest, with certain chief of the fathers, after the house of their fathers, and all of them by their names, were separated, and sat down in the first day of the tenth month to examine the matter.
verses.decoded: The people who had been taken captive did as they were told. Ezra the priest, along with some leaders from the families, organized everyone according to their family groups and names, and they gathered on the first day of the tenth month to investigate the issue.

verses.kjv: And they made an end with all the men that had taken strange wives by the first day of the first month.
verses.decoded: They finished dealing with all the men who had married foreign wives by the first day of the first month.

verses.kjv: And among the sons of the priests there were found that had taken strange wives: namely, of the sons of Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and his brethren; Maaseiah, and Eliezer, and Jarib, and Gedaliah.
verses.decoded: Among the sons of the priests, some were found who had married foreign women: specifically, among the sons of Jeshua, the son of Jozadak, and his brothers; Maaseiah, Eliezer, Jarib, and Gedaliah.

verses.kjv: And they gave their hands that they would put away their wives; and being guilty, they offered a ram of the flock for their trespass.
verses.decoded: They promised that they would send away their wives; and because they were guilty, they offered a ram from the flock as a sacrifice for their wrongdoing.

verses.kjv: And of the sons of Immer; Hanani, and Zebadiah.
verses.decoded: And from the descendants of Immer: Hanani and Zebadiah.

verses.kjv: And of the sons of Harim; Maaseiah, and Elijah, and Shemaiah, and Jehiel, and Uzziah.
verses.decoded: And from the descendants of Harim: Maaseiah, Elijah, Shemaiah, Jehiel, and Uzziah.

verses.kjv: And of the sons of Pashur; Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nethaneel, Jozabad, and Elasah.
verses.decoded: And from the sons of Pashur: Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nethaneel, Jozabad, and Elasah.

verses.kjv: Also of the Levites; Jozabad, and Shimei, and Kelaiah, (the same is Kelita,) Pethahiah, Judah, and Eliezer.
verses.decoded: Also among the Levites: Jozabad, Shimei, Kelaiah (which is Kelita), Pethahiah, Judah, and Eliezer.

verses.kjv: Of the singers also; Eliashib: and of the porters; Shallum, and Telem, and Uri.
verses.decoded: Also among the singers was Eliashib; and among the gatekeepers were Shallum, Telem, and Uri.

verses.kjv: Moreover of Israel: of the sons of Parosh; Ramiah, and Jeziah, and Malchiah, and Miamin, and Eleazar, and Malchijah, and Benaiah.
verses.decoded: Also from Israel: from the sons of Parosh; Ramiah, Jeziah, Malchiah, Miamin, Eleazar, Malchijah, and Benaiah.

verses.kjv: And of the sons of Elam; Mattaniah, Zechariah, and Jehiel, and Abdi, and Jeremoth, and Eliah.
verses.decoded: And from the descendants of Elam: Mattaniah, Zechariah, Jehiel, Abdi, Jeremoth, and Eliah.

verses.kjv: And of the sons of Zattu; Elioenai, Eliashib, Mattaniah, and Jeremoth, and Zabad, and Aziza.
verses.decoded: And from the sons of Zattu: Elioenai, Eliashib, Mattaniah, Jeremoth, Zabad, and Aziza.

verses.kjv: Of the sons also of Bebai; Jehohanan, Hananiah, Zabbai, and Athlai.
verses.decoded: Also among the sons of Bebai were Jehohanan, Hananiah, Zabbai, and Athlai.

verses.kjv: And of the sons of Bani; Meshullam, Malluch, and Adaiah, Jashub, and Sheal, and Ramoth.
verses.decoded: And from the descendants of Bani: Meshullam, Malluch, Adaiah, Jashub, Sheal, and Ramoth.

verses.kjv: And of the sons of Pahathmoab; Adna, and Chelal, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattaniah, Bezaleel, and Binnui, and Manasseh.
verses.decoded: And from the descendants of Pahath-moab: Adna, Chelal, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattaniah, Bezaleel, Binnui, and Manasseh.

verses.kjv: And of the sons of Harim; Eliezer, Ishijah, Malchiah, Shemaiah, Shimeon,
verses.decoded: And from the sons of Harim: Eliezer, Ishijah, Malchiah, Shemaiah, Shimeon,

verses.kjv: Benjamin, Malluch, and Shemariah.
verses.decoded: Benjamin, Malluch, and Shemariah.

verses.kjv: Of the sons of Hashum; Mattenai, Mattathah, Zabad, Eliphelet, Jeremai, Manasseh, and Shimei.
verses.decoded: From the sons of Hashum: Mattenai, Mattathah, Zabad, Eliphelet, Jeremai, Manasseh, and Shimei.

verses.kjv: Of the sons of Bani; Maadai, Amram, and Uel,
verses.decoded: From the descendants of Bani: Maadai, Amram, and Uel,

verses.kjv: Benaiah, Bedeiah, Chelluh,
verses.decoded: Benaiah, Bedeiah, Chelluh,

verses.kjv: Vaniah, Meremoth, Eliashib,
verses.decoded: Vaniah, Meremoth, Eliashib,

verses.kjv: Mattaniah, Mattenai, and Jaasau,
verses.decoded: Mattaniah, Mattenai, and Jaasau,

verses.kjv: And Bani, and Binnui, Shimei,
verses.decoded: And Bani, and Binnui, Shimei,

verses.kjv: And Shelemiah, and Nathan, and Adaiah,
verses.decoded: Shelemiah, Nathan, and Adaiah,

verses.kjv: Machnadebai, Shashai, Sharai,
verses.decoded: Machnadebai, Shashai, Sharai,

verses.kjv: Azareel, and Shelemiah, Shemariah,
verses.decoded: Azareel, and Shelemiah, Shemariah,

verses.kjv: Shallum, Amariah, and Joseph.
verses.decoded: Shallum, Amariah, and Joseph.

verses.kjv: Of the sons of Nebo; Jeiel, Mattithiah, Zabad, Zebina, Jadau, and Joel, Benaiah.
verses.decoded: From the descendants of Nebo: Jeiel, Mattithiah, Zabad, Zebina, Jadau, Joel, and Benaiah.

verses.kjv: All these had taken strange wives: and some of them had wives by whom they had children.
verses.decoded: All of these men had married foreign women, and some of them had children with these wives.
